concerns.text: FR-007 (DataSchemaError), FR-001 (Entropy), FR-002 (Baseline Vector), FR-003 (PSW), FR-004 (Permutation), FR-005 (Sensitivity), FR-008 (GLS fallback), and FR-009 (Category Merging) are marked as implemented in T005-T010, yet the Analyze Report explicitly flags these tasks as 'rejected' due to missing code artifacts. The tasks list claims implementation, but the current state of the project (per the report) indicates these requirements are unfulfilled. This creates a false positive coverage state where the spec requirements exist but the implementation tasks are effectively broken/incomplete.

FR-001 and US-1 require the system to ingest data and output diversity scores. Tasks T014b (Synthetic Data Generation) and T015 (Main Entry Point/Output) are marked as unchecked [ ]. The Analyze Report confirms these are 'rejected' due to missing output files (`synthetic_enrollments.csv`, `diversity_scores.json`). Without these tasks being completed, the pipeline cannot produce the data required to verify FR-001 and SC-001.

FR-008 (GLS fallback for N<30) and the requirement to detect extreme weights (US-2 Acceptance Scenario 2) are not fully covered. T023 (GLS fallback) and T024 (Extreme weight detection) are marked as unchecked [ ]. The Analyze Report flags these as 'rejected' due to missing logic. The spec requires these fallbacks to be functional, but the tasks list indicates they are not yet implemented.

FR-005 (Sensitivity Analysis) and SC-002 (Stability Metric) require a sensitivity table and a stability metric. Tasks T028a (Generate Sensitivity Table) and T028b (Verify Stability Metric) are marked as unchecked [ ]. The Analyze Report confirms these are 'rejected' due to missing output files. The spec requires these outputs to validate the robustness of the semantic threshold, but the tasks list shows they are incomplete.

FR-006 (Associational Framing) and SC-003 (False-positive rate) require verification that the analysis is presented as a sensitivity metric. Task T034 is marked as unchecked [ ]. The Analyze Report flags this as 'rejected' due to missing artifact. The spec mandates this framing, but the task to verify it is not complete.

SC-005 (6-hour runtime limit) requires performance optimization. Tasks T046 (Optimize Permutation Test) and T047 (Vectorize Metrics) are marked as unchecked [ ]. The Analyze Report flags these as 'rejected' due to missing artifacts. Without these optimizations, the pipeline may fail the SC-005 constraint.

The 'Missing Utility Function' limitation (discussed in Plan.md and Spec.md Assumptions) requires explicit documentation. Task T053 is marked as unchecked [ ]. The Analyze Report flags this as 'rejected' due to missing artifact. The spec and plan require this limitation to be documented, but the task is incomplete.

The 'Game-Theoretic Context' (Equilibrium vs. Influence) is a critical review response requirement. Tasks T054-T057 are marked as unchecked [ ]. The Analyze Report flags these as 'rejected' due to missing artifacts. The spec and plan require this discussion to address the 'payoff structure' ambiguity, but the tasks are incomplete.
